theorem.name: EXACT_LINEAR_RESTRICTION_INTERTWINING_SKETCH_REQUIRES_EXPONENTIAL_DIMENSION_V0_2
theorem.statement: Let V_n be the K-vector space with basis {e_a : a in {0,1}^n}. For each i and b in {0,1}, let R_i^b be the coordinate-restriction projector R_i^b e_a = e_a if a_i=b and 0 otherwise. Let L:V_n->W be linear. Suppose for every i,b there exists a linear operator Q_i^b on W satisfying L R_i^b = Q_i^b L, and suppose L(e_a) is nonzero for every assignment a. Then dim_K(W) >= 2^n.
proof: For a in {0,1}^n define Q_a = product_i Q_i^{a_i}. The intertwining identities imply Q_a L = L product_i R_i^{a_i}.
The product of coordinate projectors isolates one assignment: (product_i R_i^{a_i}) e_c = e_c when c=a and 0 otherwise.
Assume sum_c alpha_c L(e_c)=0. Apply Q_a. All terms vanish except alpha_a L(e_a), so alpha_a L(e_a)=0.
Because L(e_a) is nonzero, alpha_a=0. This holds for every a, so {L(e_a)} is linearly independent.

connection_to_sat.meaning: Any exact linear compressed state that must support arbitrary variable restrictions by induced linear state updates while keeping every singleton assignment distinguishable/nonzero cannot have polynomial dimension in n.
connection_to_sat.E7_relevance: E7 requires exact restriction/query support and witness reconstruction. This theorem rules out satisfying that contract with a fixed polynomial-dimensional linear state plus exact restriction-intertwining operators.
connection_to_sat.unit_clause_realization: Singleton assignments are realizable by 3-CNF using duplicated unit literals, so the nonzero-singleton requirement is present already inside the unrestricted E6 signed-3-CNF source class.

ruled_out: fixed polynomial-dimensional linear sketches with exact variable-restriction intertwining
linear spectral/message states whose exact restriction updates are represented by linear operators on the sketch
linear cancellation carriers that preserve all singleton assignment states and exact coordinate restriction semantics
not_ruled_out: adaptive algorithms whose representation changes nonlinearly after restrictions
randomized algorithms without exact linear intertwining
determinantal or cancellation constructions not equivalent to such a fixed linear sketch
